description: seastate_nhflow_vortex_si_remote on a curvilinear grid of one block (G 50 1, DIVEMesh R 20 1, blocks.dat) with the nodes of the Cartesian grid, the logical box of DIVEMesh 100 times smaller (B 1 100, B 10 4 km): the host maps between its cells and the wave grid at the physical cell centres (XC2D, YC2D), the waves get the sums per wave cell (seastate_remote_wave::map_host_grids). Against the Cartesian host (no same_as: the curvilinear discretisation differs by 4 cm of 0.59 m surge with and without waves): the wave set-up (with minus without waves) agrees within 0.8 mm of 52 mm.
covers: seastate_coupling::remote_ini_grids, remote_step_grids, fields_at at the physical centres
